hooks.text: An astronaut threw a 350-pound solar panel into space.
Why did an astronaut throw a solar panel into orbit?
NASA usually collects space debris, but an astronaut tossed some.

title: The Astronaut Who Threw a Solar Panel into Space
description: During NASA's STS-61 mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, astronaut Kathy Thornton manually jettisoned a damaged 350-pound solar array directly into orbit.

beats.text: An astronaut threw a 350-pound solar panel into space.
beats.visual: Astronaut Kathryn Thornton holding and jettisoning a solar panel during STS-61 spacewalk, 1993
queries: Kathryn Thornton solar array jettison STS-61

beats.text: High over Somalia, she simply released it into the dark.
beats.visual: Damaged solar array floating away from Space Shuttle Endeavour over Earth, 1993

beats.text: Shuttle Endeavour had grappled Hubble to fix its blurry mirror.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope grappled by Canadarm above Space Shuttle Endeavour payload bay, 1993
queries: Hubble Space Telescope grappled by Canadarm STS-61

beats.text: Astronaut Jeffrey Hoffman spotted a solar array bent ninety degrees.
beats.visual: Astronaut Jeffrey Hoffman looking through binoculars on Space Shuttle Endeavour flight deck, 1993

beats.text: The damaged wing wobbled sixteen times every day in orbit.
beats.visual: Close-up photograph of Hubble Space Telescope bent solar array in orbit, 1993

beats.text: Astronauts unmounted the array at night to avoid electrical shocks.
beats.visual: Astronauts performing a spacewalk during an orbital night pass over the Sahara Desert, 1993

beats.text: Stowing that twisted panel in Endeavour's payload bay was impossible.
beats.visual: Astronauts working on Hubble inside the illuminated cargo bay of Space Shuttle Endeavour, 1993
queries: Space Shuttle Endeavour cargo bay Hubble

beats.text: So astronaut Kathy Thornton shoved the solar array into orbit.
beats.visual: Astronaut Kathy Thornton pushing the 350-pound solar panel into open space, 1993

beats.text: It safely burned up in Earth's atmosphere.
beats.visual: Earth horizon viewed from orbit with thin glowing upper atmosphere layer, 1993
queries: Earth limb atmosphere from Space Shuttle

better_than_last: Maintained direct momentum by using a high-stakes manual action hook in beat 1 and building the mystery around why the solar panel had to be discarded before revealing the atmospheric burn payoff.
